editorial.blurb: Pho 89 serves deeply flavorful, authentically crafted pho with care—from meticulously balanced broths to perfectly cooked proteins and vibrant vegetables.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about the lunch specials and don't hesitate to customize your bowl; the staff, especially Leo and Angela, actively accommodate preferences and dietary needs with genuine warmth.

topDishes.note: A standout that reviewers rave tastes 'straight from the gods themselves'
Rich, umami-rich broth with perfectly cleaned, deveined, juicy shrimp
Unbelievably flavorful broth, especially celebrated by vegetarians and vegans
